body.library:
**Found:** `bowmark.flights`.

Always in scope, no import: `log(...args)` — progress lines; `URL` and `URLSearchParams`; `bowmark.files` — keep a file the run produces and get a link.

# Capability: Flights  (call as `bowmark.flights`)

Search flights with one call and get back normalized, price-sorted results (the same physical flight appears once). Each result carries the site it came from (`site`) and every site it was found on (`sites`). Returns `{ flights, warnings }` — `warnings` names any
